newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST - Taiwan Dec industry output - Reuters poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Taiwan Dec industry output - Reuters poll.

text.p: The following Reuters poll of economists gives their projections for year-on-year growth of Taiwan's industrial output in December.
The official figures are due to be released by the economics ministry at around 0230 GMT on January 20.
Industrial output rose 3.22 percent year-on-year in November.
The poll results produced an average forecast for a rise of 2.99 percent in annual industrial output growth in December.
Economists said they expected the island's industrial output to continue a recovery begun in July 1996.

"Since July, monthly industrial output has been on the rise. Because of strengthening domestic demand, December's industrial output should go (further) on this uptrend," said National Securities economist Lin Kuo-yang.
